content.short: NFTpay enables credit card payments for NFT projects.
content.description: Onboarding buyers who don’t have crypto or a wallet can be slow. NFTpay integrates with your existing smart contract by accepting card payments and minting NFTs on behalf of your customers. Setup is quick, requiring just a two-line script on your site. No wallet or crypto upfront is required, reducing friction. It supports major networks such as Avalanche, Ethereum, Polygon, Solana, and BNB Chain, making NFT purchases easier for a broad audience.
